script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Comedy
Theme: career transition

Begin screenplay.

---

Title: "The Pivot"

FADE IN:

EXT. SILICON VALLEY - DAY

A vibrant, bustling tech hub. Cars whiz by, people walk briskly, phones glued to their hands.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Three FRIENDS, ANNA, BEN, and JEN, sit around a table covered in laptops, coffees, and takeout boxes.

ANNA
(cheerful)
So, what's the plan for this next phase of our lives?

BEN
I'm going to learn coding. I've always been interested in technology.

JEN
Interesting. Anna, you?

ANNA
(smiling)
I'm starting a consulting business. I've got some clients already.

INT. ANNA'S APARTMENT - LIVING ROOM - DAY

Anna sits at her desk, surrounded by piles of paperwork, a laptop, and a calendar. She looks overwhelmed.

Suddenly, there's a knock on the door.

ANNA
(exasperated)
Coming!

She opens the door to reveal an old HIGH SCHOOL TEACHER, MS. HAWTHORNE.

MS. HAWTHORNE
Anna! It's so good to see you. I've heard about your new business. That's wonderful!

They chat for a while, and Ms. Hawthorne shares some valuable advice about business and life.

INT. PARK - DAY

Anna sits on a bench, eating lunch, deep in thought. She looks up and sees Ben and Jen passing by.

ANNA
(excited)
Guys! You won't believe it! Ms. Hawthorne stopped by, and she gave me some amazing advice!

BEN
(sarcastic)
Wow, that's really something.

JEN
(encouraging)
That's great, Anna. I'm proud of you.

INT. JEN'S APARTMENT - DAY

Jen sits at her desk, staring at a blank screen. She's struggling to write a script.

She looks out the window and sees a man playing the piano in the courtyard. He's playing a beautiful melody that inspires her.

JEN
(determined)
That's it. I'll write a romantic comedy.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

The friends gather once more, this time to discuss their progress.

BEN
(excited)
I've been learning JavaScript and HTML. I'm building a website!

ANNA
(smiling)
That's fantastic, Ben.

JEN
(proud)
I've written the first draft of my script. It's called "Love in the Key of C."

They all raise their coffees in a toast to their new beginnings.

INT. ANNA'S APARTMENT - LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Anna sits at her desk, surrounded by piles of paperwork, a laptop, and a calendar. But she looks happier and more focused.

INT. JEN'S APARTMENT - LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Jen sits at her desk, surrounded by stacks of scripts, a laptop, and a notebook. She's writing and rewriting, refining her craft.

INT. BEN'S APARTMENT - LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Ben sits at his desk, surrounded by textbooks, a laptop, and a code editor. He's focused and determined.

FADE OUT.

THE END
